The '''Kallidahin''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="Vader III" /> of [[humanoid]]s that lacked facial features. Although they [[Homeworld|originated]] on [[Kallidah]], they also established their presence in the [[asteroid field]] of [[Polis Massa]]. Because they stayed so long on the planetoid,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> they came to be known as '''Polis Massans'''.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Those Kallidahins were [[archaeologist]]s and exobiologists who borrowed some of the [[Kaminoan]]s' [[cloning]] techniques to attempt to recreate life from tissues recovered from archaeological digs. They excavated Polis Massa, in order to find remains of the extinct [[Eellayin]] civilization,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> ancestors to the Kallidahin.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Kallidahin were typically silent, communicating only through [[telepathy]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> The species lacked facial [[mouth]]s or [[nose]]s, but they could still [[Language|speak]] and breathe. Small and wiry statures and four-fingered hands are characteristic of the Kallidahin.<ref name="Kallidahin Databank">{{Databank|kallidahin|Kallidahin}}</ref> One Kallidahin was the [[curator]] [[Utani Xane]], but was [[Death|killed]] by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] during the [[Theft of the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix|theft]] of the [[Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix]].<ref name="Vader III" /> The Kallidahins on Polis Massa attempted to save [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] when she [[Death|died]] delivering [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].<ref name="Episode III" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kallidahin first appeared in the [[2005]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" />
[[Leland Chee]] stated on Twitter that, although it is rare, some Kallidahin have vocal cords.<ref name="Kallidahin vocal chords">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/766720749453340672|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@LelalMekha Though rare, some have vocal chords [''sic''].|archivedate=20190722071858}}</ref>
